integrity: Mathematical proof uses an explicit exhaustive exact-arithmetic certificate for every arrangement chamber, analytic constant normal-fan over the full parameter interval, and the previously proved vertex-transitivity identity. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem concerns equal-depth truncations of the regular icosahedron with 0<t<1/2 and their affine images, not endpoints or arbitrary combinatorially equivalent polyhedra. The 152-cell exact finite certificate requires checking verify.py and cells.csv. Historical priority may exist under other terminology; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact fractional illumination and a two-level directional spectrum for truncated icosahedra
